messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from the KV eviction postmortem. We need explicit owners and timelines for remediation + test additions (regression entries, prompt vectors, load profiles, chaos drill).

kevin: I can own regression automation and prompt vectors. Plan: assemble a 100-vector promptset (sanitized real sessions + synthetic hot-key patterns). Target PR by 2025-04-15.

lee: Ill own load profiles and the chaos harness. Proposing two load patterns: steady 200rps sustained, and a 10-minute spike from 100->800rps. Also a replica isolation scenario for 30s. Will draft k6 jobs and a chaos runbook.

maria: Who wires these into CI and gate deploys? We want canary gating and nightly runs that fail fast on regressions that increase tail latency or kv-miss ratio.

dana: Ops will add the canary job. Gate on absolute SLAs (p99 < 120ms, p999 < 220ms) and relative kv-miss delta > 8% vs baseline. Add perf-budget annotation to PRs.

kevin: Promptset will live in tests/promptsets/kv_tail.json with metadata and baseline metrics. Ill include key skew and hot-key cohorts.

lee: Chaos harness outline (will use safe chaos tooling, not iptables):
run_load(pattern="spike", rps=[100,800], duration=600)
wait(30)
isolate_node(tag="replica-3", duration=30)
observe(metrics=["kv_hit_rate","p99_latency","cpu"])
Will include safe-run flag and deny-production default.

maria: Add alerts: page oncall if canary fails, and escalate to #incidents if nightly reg-suite fails 3x in a row. Include rollback playbook link in PRs.

dana: Created INF-5007 to track owners/timelines. Assigned kevin+lee. Due 2025-04-20.

ops-bot: Created INF-5007: "KV tail remediation + tests" assigned to kevin,lee, due 2025-04-20.

kevin: Question on CI cadence: smoke on weekdays, full nightly on infra runners, extended weekly soak? Cost vs coverage tradeoff.

maria: Sounds good: smoke weekdays, full nightly, weekly 3h soak in staging. That balances cost and signal.

lee: Ill post the chaos drill checklist to #runbooks with pre-checks, abort conditions, dashboard links, and recovery steps.

maria: OK team  tag me in PRs and add short status updates to INF-5007. Exec summary: single owners per stream, clear timelines, CI gating, and recurrence detection to identify similar incidents.

dana: Ill add a backlog item to detect recurring KV-tail signatures across incidents.

maria: Thanks all, lets aim to have CI gating and initial PRs before next deploy. :thumbsup:
